fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects suspicious process command line that uses base64 encoded input for execution with a shell
fields.name: Linux Base64 Encoded Pipe to Shell
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "base64 " and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "| bash " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "| sh " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "|bash " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "|sh ") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains " |sh" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "| bash" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "| sh" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "|bash"))))
